title: Real Horror Movie Hotels You Can Book
description: Two real hotels linked to The Shining: Timberline Lodge, the Overlook's exterior, and the Stanley Hotel that inspired Stephen King's novel.
h1: Real hotels from horror movies you can stay in
intro: The scariest hotel in cinema has real-world counterparts, and both welcome guests. One gave The Shining its look, the other gave Stephen King the idea.

hotels.note: Stanley Kubrick used the lodge's exterior for the snowbound Overlook in The Shining (1980). The interiors were built on sound stages in England, and there is no Room 237 here.
This Colorado hotel inspired Stephen King's original novel, and the 1997 TV miniseries was filmed here. It also played the Danbury Hotel in the comedy Dumb and Dumber.

outro: Both hotels are far friendlier than their screen reputations suggest, so expect cosy rooms and great mountain views rather than ghosts.
